newsitem.title: USA: International Thoroughbred issues 2.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: International Thoroughbred issues 2.1 mln shares.

text.p: International Thoroughbred Breeders Inc said on Tuesday that it issued 2.1 million common shares to a Las Vegas Entertainment Network Inc subsidiary, in exchange for the cancellation of a $10.5 million secured promissory note.
International Thoroughbred said in a news release that it issued the note to another Las Vegas Entertainment unit, Country Land Properties Inc.

The 2,093,868 shares were issued to Casino-Co Corp, a wholly owned Las Vegas Entertainment subsidiary, based on a $5.00 per share valuation. International shares closed Tuesday down 1/8 to 4-3/8 on the American Stock Exchange.

International Thoroughbred also said it issued another 232,652 shares to its principal lender, Credit Suisse First Boston Mortgage Capital LLC, in consideration of Credit Suisse's consent to the conversion of the note.
International Thoroughbred said it issued the note in connection with the acquisition of the El Rancho property in Las Vegas.
The company also said it was discussing with Las Vegas the acquisition of Casino-Co.
International Thoroughbred owns and manages racetracks.
